# Purchase Order Lines

Part of the **Purchases** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List purchase order lines

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/lines`

Retrieve a paginated list of line items for a specific purchase order

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `purchase_order_id` | integer | Yes | The purchase order ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: uom, product, productPackaging, order, partner, currency, company, creator, finalLocation, taxes | `product,taxes` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of line IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[product_id]` | string | No | Filter by product IDs |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `-id` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/lines?include=product%2Ctaxes&sort=-id&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/lines?include=product%2Ctaxes&sort=-id&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/lines?include=product%2Ctaxes&sort=-id&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/lines?include=product%2Ctaxes&sort=-id&page=1"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

## Show purchase order line

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/purchases/purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}/lines/{id}`

Retrieve a specific line item from a purchase order

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `purchase_order_id` | integer | Yes | The purchase order ID |
| `id` | integer | Yes | The purchase order line ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: uom, product, productPackaging, order, partner, currency, company, creator, finalLocation, taxes | `product,taxes` |



::: code-group
